fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Isolate the rogue cell via RAN’s TAC filtering rules.
Enforce NAS security mode commands (SMC) with strict ciphering.
Block unrecognized IMSI prefixes in MME/SMF via policy controls.
Deploy NAS replay attack detection with sequence number checks.
Enable 5G NAS integrity protection for all NAS messages.
Set NAS timer T3502 to 10 seconds to reject delayed responses.
Update MME/SMF to reject invalid NAS messages with EMM_CAUSE=125.
Deploy 5G NAS authentication with SUPI-based integrity checks.
Monitor NAS traces for repeated unmasked IMSI attachments.
Trigger automated RAN blacklisting for cells with NAS anomalies.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
